text:
anna: Heads up — we need to align on a cohort retirement matrix for v1->v2 migration. L10N-heavy customers are blocking unless we define non-blocking migration lanes.
liam: Can we avoid hard pinning for localized cohorts? my high-level: staggered TTL + compatibility shim + cohort-specific canaries.
sara: Agree in principle. We need concrete bench criteria for localized quality (not just token-level diffs). proposing semantic similarity + small human audit.
mike: From infra: v2 has a kv-cache layout change and different quant profile. Fallback rehosting cost is non-trivial. need preflight perf/compat tests.
anna: Proposed launch gates (draft):
- quality: semantic-sim score >= 0.88 on sample set + human spot-check pass for 5% of failing cases
- perf: p95 latency delta <= 10% vs pinned baseline
- reliability: fallback error-rate < 1% during canary
- rollout: 2-week A/B canary on 10% traffic per cohort
liam: 1000 prompts per locale is heavy. suggest sampling: 200 core prompts + 50 edge prompts per locale, plus weighted sampling for high-traffic customers.
sara: Metric specifics: use embedding cosine (all models produce 1536-d for our eval harness) and normalized ROUGE-L for long responses. human adjudication if cosine in [0.84,0.88].
mike: Ops rollback triggers: >1% client error rate OR sustained cost delta >30% for 24h OR unexplained regression in embedding sim >0.05.
anna: Also need an SDK compatibility smoke: ensure streaming API contract hasn't changed. if it has, must ship minor shim.
liam: Sketch of a compatibility shim config (pseudo):
```
{
  "cohort": "l10n-eu-1",
  "pin_ttl_days": 21,
  "canary_pct": 10,
  "fallback_model": "v1-compat",
  "quality_gate": { "embed_cosine": 0.88, "human_review_rate": 0.05 }
}
```
sara: For human review: ops handles sampling but product provides adjudication rubric (content preservation, hallucination, tone). I'll draft rubric.
mike: Capacity plan: dedicate a 2-node canary pool per major region for cohorts >5k monthly qps. autoscale policy: scale to 150% baseline for first 48h of canary.
anna: Owners/deadlines:
- bench harness & locale sampling: sara, due EOD next Wed
- infra preflight & canary config: mike, due EOD next Fri
- rollout policy + customer comms: liam, draft by next Tue
liam: I'll draft the comms + migration opt-out flow. we should offer temporary credits for customers who opt for extended pin.
anna: Decision needed: do we allow per-customer pin extensions (yes/no)? leaning yes but gated (paid + tech review). :thinking_face:
sara: +1 for paid extension. we need telemetry flags to track pinned traffic. :thumbsup:
mike: We need a small API change to expose pin metadata to billing; I'll spec that once owners confirmed.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: cohort l10n-eu-1 canary started at 2026-03-22T14:15:00Z (10% traffic).
liam: noted the canary start — will monitor metrics dashboard. :eyes:
anna: Great. I'll consolidate these gates into a short playbook and post in #product by EOD. If anyone has objections to the thresholds above speak up now.
sara: No objections from me.
mike: all good from infra side.
liam: LGTM
anna: Thanks — closing this sync.
